videos.headline: Mehidy Hasan Miraz to Axar, out Bowled!! That's a five-wicket haul for Mehidy Hasan Miraz! And the crowd erupts! Was a fuller delivery on leg, and it kept straight and low. Axar looks to defend this, but it clips the pads and knocks down the leg-stump. Bangladesh need three more wickets to register a historic win. A handy contribution by Axar, but won't be enough for India as they still need 71 runs more.. Axar b Mehidy Hasan Miraz 34(69) [4s-4]

Mehidy Hasan Miraz to Pant, out Lbw!! Mehidy Hasan Miraz on fire! Pant walks up to Axar and has a discussion, but the latter reckons this was out. They don't take the review. Was a flatter delivery that kept straight and Pant got rapped on the pads as he tried to defend it. Impact in line, and it might have crashed into the sticks, reckons the umpire. The spectators are absolutely loving this. Mehidy Hasan Miraz is only one wicket away from registering a five-wicket haul. Did the damage with the bat in the ODIs, and he is weaving his spin magic in this Test. Pant lbw b Mehidy Hasan Miraz 9(13) [4s-1]

Shakib to Unadkat, out Lbw!! Now Unadkat reviews! He has been given out LBW, and he has decided to challenge the call.. Looking at replays, this looks plumb! Was a flatter delivery around off and the batter was trying to cut it away. The ball skids along the deck and clips the pads in front of the wickets. Impact in line and it's crashing into the sticks, confirms Hawkeye. India lose a review.. That's the first wicket of the morning as India are five down. Bangladesh need 5 wickets, India need 89 runs.. Unadkat lbw b Shakib 13(16) [6s-1]

Mehidy Hasan Miraz to Kohli, out Caught by Mominul!! Excellent catch at short leg and this is HUGE! What a passage of play this is for Bangladesh! They had gotten some momentum with their lower order fightback in the batting and are now turning it on here in Mirpur. Kohli was lunging and defending at every spinning delivery, so this was actually on the cards. Mehidy got one to land on that good length spot, not full enough to be defending off the front foot and Kohli gets an inside edge on it. Sharp low take by Mominul at short leg. Excellent reflexes!! There is some spice in the action as Kohli isn't happy with the Bangladesh fielders celebrating in his face. Stands there and there is some momentary eye contact as well before he is forced to go away. Shakib immediately steps in to calm his boys and reminds them that the job is far from over. Kohli c Mominul b Mehidy Hasan Miraz 1(22)

Mehidy Hasan Miraz to Pujara, out Stumped!! A brain fade from Pujara! This is so unlike him and Bangladesh have a massive breakthrough. We've seen Pujara use his feet against spin so often but what always stands out is his clarity on whether to defend or attack. On this occasion, he does neither. Walks down early, not quite to the pitch as Mehidy drags the length back and beats the outside edge comfortably. It's a regulation stumping but Nurul fumbles initially before taking the bails off. As it turns out, that's enough to get rid of Pujara. The bat was in the air when the bails came off. Pujara st Nurul Hasan b Mehidy Hasan Miraz 6(12) [4s-1]

Shakib to Rahul, out Caught by Nurul Hasan!! Edged and taken! Dream start for Bangladesh. Was a tossed up delivery outside off and it spins away sharply to catch Rahul's outside edge. Was playing a forward defence, but the edge was induced due to the turn. Nurul Hasan takes a sharp catch behind the wickets and that's yet another failure for Rahul in Tests. Never thrives under pressure to be honest. 12, 10, 22, 23, 10, 2 - his scores in the last 6 Test innings. Rahul c Nurul Hasan b Shakib 2(7)

Siraj to Litton Das, out Bowled!! Relief for India! They have finally managed to break the partnership, and it's the important wicket of Litton Kumer Das! And Siraj looks pumped as he puts his finger on his lips to celebrate the wicket, in fact he does that to silence the crowd. Was a sharp nip-backer by the pacer and it breached the batter's defence. The stumps have been rattled and Litton walks back after playing a fantastic knock of 73. Bangladesh lead by 132 runs with 2 wickets to go.. Litton Das b Siraj 73(98) [4s-7]

Axar to Nurul Hasan, out Stumped!! Axar has broken the stand! Just like the second innings in the first game, Nurul Hasan is out stumped to Axar. The length draws the batter forward and Axar gets it to spin past the outside edge. The momentum took the batter out of his ground. Nurul, looking to push it into the off-side, was nowhere close to the pitch of the ball. Pant is quick to break the sticks. Third wicket for Axar and the counter-attacking knock from Nurul comes to an end. Nurul Hasan st Pant b Axar 31(29) [4s-2 6s-1]

Axar to Mehidy Hasan Miraz, out Lbw!! Mehidy walks straight into the trap! It's dead plumb and he has a chat with Litton Das before walking off. Rightly decides against the review. But this is another wicket thrown away by Bangladesh. There was a massive gap on the leg-side, inviting Mehidy to go across the line but it was always risky against the left-arm spinner. Mehidy accepts the invitation, goes for the slog sweep and is totally done by the length here. It's a bit too full, skids on and pings him on the back leg. As plumb as it gets. Mehidy Hasan Miraz lbw b Axar 0(5)

Umesh Yadav to Zakir Hasan, out Caught by Siraj!! Such a poor shot from Zakir! Did all the hard work of getting himself in and then just throws it away. Can't be too critical of a boy who is just playing his second Test match but even then, this is inexcusable. Was a harmless widish delivery, a tad full and Zakir momentarily channelled his limited-overs mode, slicing uppishly over backward point. More of an ambitious square-drive and it's straight down to Siraj who takes a good low catch at third man. Just when a partnership was looking promising for Bangladesh, India have struck. Zakir Hasan c Siraj b Umesh Yadav 51(135) [4s-5]

Axar to Mushfiqur, out Lbw!! Axar has looked dangerous so far, and he strikes at the stroke of lunch. Keeps this fraction short on middle and the ball skids along the deck to beat Mushfiqur's defence. Misses the inside edge by a whisker and the replays confirm this would have crashed into middle and leg. Bangladesh still trail by 17 runs with most of their mainstays back in the pavilion. Going to be a tricky phase for the new batter with only an over or two remaining before the break. Mushfiqur lbw b Axar 9(19)

Unadkat to Shakib, out Caught by Shubman Gill!! Unadkat strikes in his first over of the day! That's a pretty soft dismissal. Unadkat has been pretty impressive on his Test comeback, making all that domestic experience count. Hits the deck on a length and the ball sticks into the surface to an extent. Shakib checks his shot and ends up chipping it straight to cover. Gill stationed there takes a comfortable catch to his left and the Bangladesh captain walks back to the hut. Shakib c Shubman Gill b Unadkat 13(36) [4s-1]

Siraj to Mominul, out Caught by Pant!! Siraj has his revenge! 135kph, full and wide of off around the fifth stump zone and it straightens a bit. A squared up Mominul is on the move (forward) as he pushes at it and gets an outside edge that carries through to the keeper. Siraj knew that there was a thin nick and even the batsman didn't wait for the umpire's decision. The top-scorer in the first innings has been nipped out early! Mominul c Pant b Siraj 5(9) [4s-1]

Ashwin to Shanto, out Lbw!! Another lbw appeal and this time umpire Chris Brown raises his finger. Shanto has a word with Zakir Hasan and sends it upstairs just in time. Quicker one from Ashwin and Shanto was stuck in his crease. Missed the glance to get pinned on the back leg adjacent to the sticks. Clearly no bat, confirmed by UltraEdge. Over to ball-tracking and it's three reds! Hitting middle and leg. Bangladesh lose Shanto as well as a review! Ashwin strikes early on day three. Eventful first over from the Indian offspinner. It was the slider and the ball went on straight with the arm, the batter was late into his shot as the ball skidded off the deck. Shanto lbw b Ashwin 5(31) [4s-1]

Shakib to Shreyas Iyer, out Lbw!! That's the third wicket of the session for Bangladesh. They are back in it! Was a tossed up delivery by Shakib and it kept slightly low, Shreyas Iyer was down on his knee to play the sweep, but gets beaten due to the lack of bounce. Pitching in line, impact in line, and it's crashing into the stumps, reckon the replays. Both - Iyer and Pant have missed out on their centuries. Shreyas Iyer lbw b Shakib 87(105) [4s-10 6s-2]

Shakib to Axar, out Caught by Shanto! Axar departs early! A tossed up delivery by Shakib, entices with this loopy delivery. Axar falls for the bait and goes for the lofted shot and Shanto at long-on takes the catch. The momentum pushes him towards the boundary, but he has managed to avoid contact with the cushions. A couple of wickets in quick succession for Bangladesh as India's lead is only 37 runs. Axar c Shanto b Shakib 4(11) [4s-1]

Mehidy Hasan Miraz to Pant, out Caught by Nurul Hasan!! Pant is out in the 90s again! Sixth time in the 90s.. A tossed up delivery outside off, spinning away from the batter, Pant has a feeble poke at it and gets an outside edge that has been taken by the keeper. Deserved a century for the way he has played in this innings. 159-run stand broken by Mehidy Hasan Miraz! Pant c Nurul Hasan b Mehidy Hasan Miraz 93(105) [4s-7 6s-5]

Taskin Ahmed to Kohli, out Caught by Nurul Hasan!! Taskin has his man this time and it's with a cracking delivery! Much-needed early breakthrough for Bangladesh after lunch and it's the big one of Kohli. It's that corridor of uncertainty that's plagued him a lot in recent years in Test cricket. This angles into him and straightens just a fraction, enough to find the outside edge and Nurul Hasan does the rest. Kohli could have probably left this alone but the angle made him play at this and he probably wasn't expecting the ball to do anything off the pitch. Terrific stuff from Taskin and good captaincy from Shakib too, because it would have been easy to go spin from both ends on this wearing surface. Kohli c Nurul Hasan b Taskin Ahmed 24(73) [4s-3]

Taijul Islam to Pujara, out Caught by Mominul!! That's a sharp catch by Mominul at short leg. Pujara is standing there in disbelief as he thinks this hasn't been caught cleanly. The soft signal is OUT though. Mominul has enough fingers underneath the ball, it's a clean catch, reckon the replays. Was a fuller delivery by Taijul Islam as Pujara nudged it towards the close-in fielder. Sharp reflexes shown by Mominul as he takes it with his left hand. The zoomer confirms the same and that brings an end to Pujara's stay. India lose their third wicket of the session and Taijul Islam has been superb this morning.. Pujara c Mominul b Taijul Islam 24(55) [4s-2]

Taijul Islam to Shubman Gill, out Lbw!! Gone! Taijul Islam has removed both the Indian openers. And he's on a celebratory run. It's fullish and on the stumps, Shubman Gill gets down to sweep and fails to lay bat on ball. The impact on the front pad is in front of the sticks. The appeal was convincing, the dreaded finger went up quickly and the batter walks off. Ball-tracking shows it to be crashing into middle. Plumb! Shubman Gill lbw b Taijul Islam 20(39) [4s-1 6s-1]

Taijul Islam to Rahul, out Lbw!! 83kph, confident appeal for lbw, struck down. The bowler persuades the captain to review it. Rahul had danced down the track. Wasn't quite to the pitch of the ball and decided to block it out. But it hit his front pad first although the bat wasn't too far away. The same has been conformed by UltraEdge. Over to ball-tracking and it's three reds! Hitting middle of middle and leg. Taijul Islam provides the breakthrough, he knew that Rahul was a goner as soon as it pinned the batter's pad. The impact was quite low as well. Bangladesh are elated with this successful review. Rahul lbw b Taijul Islam 10(45) [4s-1]

Umesh Yadav to Taskin Ahmed, out Caught by Siraj!! That's wicket no.4 for Umesh Yadav! Was pitched up by the pacer around off and it straightened off the deck slightly. Taskin Ahmed goes for a drive, but closes the bat face slightly and the leading edge flies straight to point. Siraj stationed there fumbles twice or thrice, but he manages to latch on to it eventually. He was a bit casual when he completed the catch actually. Would have been an embarrassing moment had he dropped it due to his complacency. Taskin Ahmed c Siraj b Umesh Yadav 1(16)

Umesh Yadav to Mehidy Hasan Miraz, out Caught by Pant!! The bowling change works. 130kph, innocuous length ball wide of off, Mehidy Hasan Miraz lazily wafts his bat for a cut sany any feet movement and nicks off to the keeper. The 41-run stand has been broken. Mehidy Hasan Miraz c Pant b Umesh Yadav 15(51) [4s-3]

Ashwin to Litton Das, out Caught by Rahul!! The bowling change works! Siraj made way for Ashwin this over and it's worked instantly. The pacer could have perhaps got one more over with the way Das was taking him on but KL's instincts thought otherwise and it's worked. Lovely bowling from Ashwin, classical off break, draws the batter forward and Das' flick is a bit too lazy. It's uppish as well and picks out short mid-wicket perfectly. This innings sums up Das perfectly - looked a million dollars at the crease with some jaw-dropping strokes and then just loses the plot with bad shot-selection. Timely breakthrough for India. Litton Das c Rahul b Ashwin 25(26) [4s-2 6s-1]

Unadkat to Mushfiqur, out Caught by Pant!! Excellent delivery!! Unadkat has deserved a lot more wickets than the solitary scalp he had taken till this point and he is now rewarded with his second scalp. Crafty stuff from the left-arm seamer, angling this in from around off stump and the angle forced Mushfiqur to have a poke at this. However, it jagged away off the seam with extra bounce to find the edge and Pant did the rest. How often have seen a wicket just after a drinks break? It's happened yet again. Mushfiqur c Pant b Unadkat 26(46) [4s-5]

Umesh Yadav to Shakib, out Caught by Pujara!! Umesh Yadav strikes first ball after lunch! That's a poor shot by the experienced batter. This was pitched up by Umesh Yadav and Shakib tries to take the aerial route. Chips it straight to the fielder at mid-off and Bangladesh lose their third wicket right after the break. Perfect start for Umesh.. Shakib c Pujara b Umesh Yadav 16(39) [4s-1 6s-1]

Ashwin to Shanto, out Lbw!! Shanto has been given out lbw as he offers no shot. Has a word with his batting partner and sends it upstairs. In-drifter, not much spin, the impact is outside off (but that's not an issue as the batter shouldered arms). Ball-tracking is in and it's clipping the off-stump (umpire's call). A wicket for Ashwin in his third over and a distraight Shanto walks back to the dressing room. Bangladesh have lost both their openers in quick succession. Shanto lbw b Ashwin 24(57) [4s-3]

Unadkat to Zakir Hasan, out Caught by Rahul!! There's the extra bounce and there's the wicket. Maiden Test wicket for Jaydev Unadkat! The Indians are cock-a-hoop! 128kph, short of length ball that seams in with extra bounce. Zakir Hasan gets into a tangle looking to play a horizontal-batted stroke. He's cramped for room as well and the ball lobs up towards fourth slip off the glove. Simple catch for Rahul. Zakir Hasan c Rahul b Unadkat 15(34) [4s-1]
